hop.rule: the A-to-B fence's two clauses: 'the product or grid taken as the universe the enumerator counts against is here' versus 'what one of the product's empty cells yields, a predicted member or an errand, is form-yields'''. The seat read the case's subject as the universe and its errands as evidence for the manufactured denominator, so the first clause held it. A case constructed to sit on Quadrat, whose own illustration is the blank that sends a recorder, crossed two fences and was kept by the third.
